channel.title: Deployment Management on KubeSphere
channel.description: Recent content in Deployment Management on KubeSphere

item.title: View Application List
item.description: This section describes how to view the list of deployed applications. Prerequisites You need to have the App Store Management permission on the KubeSphere platform. For more information, see Users and Platform Roles. The KubeSphere App Store Management extension must be installed and enabled on the KubeSphere platform. Steps Log in to the KubeSphere web console as a user with App Store Management permissions.

item.title: View Application Details
item.description: This section describes how to view the details of a deployed application. Prerequisites You need to have the App Store Management permission on the KubeSphere platform. For more information, see Users and Platform Roles. The KubeSphere App Store Management extension must be installed and enabled on the KubeSphere platform. Steps Log in to the KubeSphere web console as a user with App Store Management permissions.

item.title: Edit Application Information
item.description: This section describes how to edit the information of a deployed application. You can edit the alias and description of an application. KubeSphere does not support editing the name of a deployed application. Prerequisites You need to have the App Store Management permission on the KubeSphere platform. For more information, see Users and Platform Roles. The KubeSphere App Store Management extension must be installed and enabled on the KubeSphere platform.

Steps Log in to the KubeSphere web console as a user with App Store Management permissions.

item.title: Deploy Applications from the App Store
item.description: This section describes how to deploy applications from the App Store on the App Store Management page. Prerequisites You need to have the App Store Management permission on the KubeSphere platform. For more information, see Users and Platform Roles. The KubeSphere App Store Management extension must be installed and enabled on the KubeSphere platform. Steps Log in to the KubeSphere web console as a user with App Store Management permissions.
